map.计算HOMA-IR(稳态模型评估胰岛素抵抗)和HOMA-β，评估胰岛素敏感性和β: Compute HOMA-IR (the steady-state model of insulin resistance) and HOMA-β to assess insulin sensitivity and beta-cell function
Core formulas (by input): (20 × insulin) ÷ (fpg - 3.5); min(100, (homaIR ÷ 8) × 100); (insulin × fpg) ÷ 22.5

map.显著IR，T2DM/PCOS高风险: Marked IR, high risk of T2DM/PCOS
map.注：中国人群HOMA-IR≥2.69常作为胰岛素抵抗切点。不同实验室和人群切点可: Note: in Chinese populations HOMA-IR ≥2.69 is often used as the insulin-resistance cut-off. Cut-offs vary by laboratory and population, so local standards are the reference.
map.不同人群 HOMA-IR 临床应用: Clinical use of HOMA-IR across populations
map.IR是PCOS核心病理，指导二甲双胍治疗: IR is the core pathology of PCOS and guides metformin treatment
map.IR是NAFLD关键驱动因素: IR is a key driver of NAFLD

map.血糖单位 mmol/L，胰岛素单位 mIU/L。22.5为正常血糖3.5mmol: Glucose is in mmol/L and insulin in mIU/L. 22.5 is the conversion constant for a normal glucose of 3.5 mmol/L.
map.HOMA-IR适用于空腹状态评估，不适用于T1DM、妊娠糖尿病和使用胰岛素的患者: HOMA-IR applies to fasting assessment and is not suitable for type 1 diabetes, gestational diabetes or patients on insulin. HOMA-β accuracy falls when hyperglycaemia is severe; an OGTT insulin release test or clamp study is better for marked hyperglycaemia. Fasting for 8-12 hours is required before the blood draw.
map.人群代谢综合征横断面调查中的胰岛素抵抗分层。: Stratifying insulin resistance in population cross-sectional metabolic studies.
map.糖尿病前期人群的 β 细胞功能趋势评估。: Tracking beta-cell function trends in prediabetes populations.
map.减重/运动干预前后胰岛素敏感性变化的对照。: Comparing insulin sensitivity before and after weight-loss or exercise intervention.
map.空腹血糖 5.8 mmol/L、空腹胰岛素 15 mU/L：HOMA-IR=(5: Fasting glucose 5.8 mmol/L and fasting insulin 15 mU/L: HOMA-IR=(5.8×15)/22.5=3.87 (indicating resistance); HOMA-β=(20×15)/(5.8−3.5)=130% (beta cells still compensating). Values shift with the reagent and the population cut-off.
map.HOMA-IR 与 HOMA-β 要结合看吗？: Should HOMA-IR and HOMA-β be read together?
map.是。HOMA-IR 高提示抵抗，HOMA-β 高提示 β 细胞仍在代偿；若 β: Yes. High HOMA-IR indicates resistance and high HOMA-β means beta cells are still compensating; if beta-cell function declines while IR persists, this points towards impaired glucose tolerance or diabetes.
map.研究中使用要注意什么？: What should be watched when using it in studies?
map.需统一空腹条件、胰岛素检测方法（RIA vs CLIA 结果不可直接比），并在论: Standardise the fasting conditions and the insulin assay method (RIA and CLIA results are not directly comparable), and report the source of the cut-off in the paper.
map.HOMA-IR是临床最常用的胰岛素抵抗评估指数，仅需空腹血糖和胰岛素即可计算，适: HOMA-IR is the most widely used clinical index of insulin resistance and needs only fasting glucose and insulin, fitting the assessment of metabolic syndrome, PCOS and NAFLD.
